title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造~Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings
focus: 以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷~Period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage
summary: 從鹽湖城市郡大樓、舊金山市政府與猶他州議會大廈的隔震改造出發，計算隔震後的週期、位移與扭轉放大，設計鉛心橡膠支承與後拉預力托換梁，再處理切柱頂升的荷載轉移、施工期間的地震風險、原型與出廠試驗、強震監測，最後談性質變化的上下限分析、隔震縫維護與交接。~Starting from the isolation retrofits of the Salt Lake City and County Building, San Francisco City Hall and the Utah State Capitol, compute isolated period, displacement and torsional amplification, design lead-rubber bearings and post-tensioned transfer girders, then handle load transfer by cutting and jacking, earthquake risk during construction, prototype and production tests and strong-motion monitoring, and finally upper- and lower-bound property analysis, moat maintenance and handover.

units.title: 週期延長與隔震改造的動機~Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building
units.mechanism: 許多既有建築，尤其是無筋磚造或石造的歷史建築，強度與韌性都不足，以傳統方式加剪力牆或斜撐，會大量破壞內部裝飾與空間。基礎隔震改從需求端下手：在建築下方插入水平柔軟的隔震層，把系統週期由約 0.5 s 延長到 2 至 3 s 以上，地震加速度大幅降低，上部結構幾乎以剛體平移，變形集中在隔震層。代價是隔震層要容納數十公分的位移，並需處理建築周邊的隔震縫與穿越管線。Forell/Elsesser 指出，鹽湖城市郡大樓是全球第一個以基礎隔震改造的既有建築。~Many existing buildings, especially unreinforced masonry or stone landmarks, lack strength and ductility, and conventional strengthening with shear walls or braces would destroy much of their interior fabric. Base isolation attacks demand instead: a laterally flexible isolation layer inserted beneath the building lengthens the period from about 0.5 s to 2 to 3 s or more, sharply reducing earthquake acceleration so that the superstructure moves almost as a rigid body while deformation concentrates in the isolation layer. The price is that the layer must accommodate tens of centimetres of displacement, with a moat around the building and flexible utility crossings. Forell/Elsesser describes the Salt Lake City and County Building as the world's first base-isolation retrofit of an existing building.
units.model: T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff))。W = 216,000 kN、54 個隔震器各 K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m（K ≈ 90,650 kN/m），T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×90,650)) ≈ 3.1 s。以 S_D1 = 0.7、阻尼修正 B = 1.35，基底剪力係數 S_D1/(T·B) = 0.7/(3.1×1.35) ≈ 0.17，而固定基底 0.5 s 時約為 1.0，約降為六分之一。數值為教學假設。~T = 2π√(W/(g·K_eff)). With W = 216,000 kN and 54 isolators of K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m each (K ≈ 90,650 kN/m), T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×90,650)) ≈ 3.1 s. With S_D1 = 0.7 and damping coefficient B = 1.35, the base-shear coefficient is S_D1/(T·B) = 0.7/(3.1×1.35) ≈ 0.17, against about 1.0 for the fixed base at 0.5 s, roughly one sixth. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以既有建築調查得到的材料強度與重量建立模型，比較固定基底與隔震兩種方案的樓層加速度、層間變位與上部結構需求強度比；同時評估場址是否為軟弱土層或近斷層，因為長週期地動會削弱隔震效益，必要時做場址反應分析。~Build a model from surveyed material strengths and weights, compare floor accelerations, drifts and superstructure demand-to-capacity ratios for fixed-base and isolated schemes, and check whether the site is soft soil or near-fault, since long-period ground motion erodes the benefit, performing site-response analysis where needed.
units.failure: 若在軟弱土層上隔震而未做場址分析，地動的長週期能量正好落在隔震週期附近，位移遠超過預期，撞擊隔震縫邊牆；若上部結構過於柔軟或有軟弱層，變形不會只集中在隔震層，仍可能損傷。~Isolating on soft soil without site analysis can put long-period ground-motion energy right at the isolated period, so displacement far exceeds expectations and the building strikes the moat wall; a flexible superstructure or soft storey keeps deformation from concentrating in the isolation layer and still allows damage.
units.misconception: 隔震改造會讓建築在地震中完全不動。~Base isolation makes a building stay completely still in an earthquake.
units.practice: 可行性研究階段就要比較隔震與傳統補強在文化資產衝擊、停用期間、造價與性能目標上的差異，並把性能目標（例如震後立即使用）寫進設計基準由業主確認。~At feasibility stage compare isolation with conventional strengthening for heritage impact, closure time, cost and performance, and write the performance objective, for example immediate occupancy after the earthquake, into the design basis for the owner to confirm.

units.anchor: 隔震縫與隔震面~Moat and isolation plane
units.title: 隔震面位置、扭轉放大與隔震縫~Isolation-plane location, torsional amplification and the moat
units.mechanism: 改造時隔震面的位置決定了工程難度：放在地下室底部要開挖並托換基礎，放在地下室柱頂則地下室仍隨地盤運動。隔震面正上方必須有一層剛性樓板或格梁，把各柱連成整體，讓所有隔震器同步變形。建築的質心與隔震層勁度中心若不重合，扭轉會使角落隔震器的位移大於中心，所以隔震縫寬度要按最大總位移而非平均位移設計，並保留所有穿越管線與通道的可動接頭。~The location of the isolation plane governs the difficulty of a retrofit: at the base of the basement it requires excavation and underpinning, while at basement column tops the basement still moves with the ground. A stiff diaphragm or grid of beams is needed directly above the isolators to tie the columns together so that all isolators deform together. If the centre of mass does not coincide with the centre of isolator stiffness, torsion makes corner isolators move more than central ones, so the moat must be sized for the total maximum displacement rather than the average, with movable joints for every utility and access crossing.
units.model: 以 ASCE 7-10 型式的扭轉放大 D_TM = D_M·[1 + y·12e/(b² + d²)]。平面 60 m × 30 m、偶然偏心 e = 5%×60 = 3 m、角落距離 y = 30 m：12×3×30/(3,600+900) = 0.24，D_M = 0.40 m 時 D_TM ≈ 0.40×1.24 ≈ 0.50 m，隔震縫淨寬取 0.55 m 以上。數值為教學假設。~Using the ASCE 7-10 form of torsional amplification, D_TM = D_M·[1 + y·12e/(b² + d²)]. For a 60 m × 30 m plan, accidental eccentricity e = 5%×60 = 3 m and corner distance y = 30 m: 12×3×30/(3,600+900) = 0.24, so D_M = 0.40 m gives D_TM ≈ 0.40×1.24 ≈ 0.50 m and the moat clear width should be at least 0.55 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以三維模型做雙向地震的非線性時間歷程分析，檢查每個隔震器的最大位移、最大與最小軸力（含上浮），並確認隔震縫、樓梯、電梯坑與管線在最大總位移下不碰撞；設計圖上逐一標示各穿越點的允許位移量。~Run three-dimensional nonlinear time-history analysis with bidirectional records to check each isolator's maximum displacement and maximum and minimum axial force, including uplift, and confirm that the moat, stairs, lift pits and utilities do not collide at the total maximum displacement; mark the allowable movement at every crossing on the drawings.
units.failure: 隔震縫寬度只按中心位移設計時，角落在強震中撞擊擋土牆，撞擊產生的高頻加速度與剪力傳回上部結構，抵銷隔震效益；隔震面上方缺乏剛性樓板，各隔震器不同步變形，部分柱承受額外彎矩。~A moat sized for the central displacement lets corners strike the retaining wall in a strong earthquake, sending high-frequency acceleration and shear back into the superstructure and cancelling the isolation benefit; without a stiff diaphragm above, isolators deform unevenly and some columns pick up extra moment.
units.misconception: 隔震縫寬度只要等於設計位移即可，不必考慮扭轉。~The moat width only needs to equal the design displacement, without considering torsion.
units.practice: 隔震縫的蓋板、伸縮踏板與管線可動接頭應列入圖說與驗收項目，並在現場以油漆或標牌標示「隔震縫內不得堆放或施作」；任何穿越隔震面的新設施都須經結構技師核可。~Moat covers, sliding treads and flexible utility joints should be shown on drawings and included in acceptance, and the moat should be marked on site as a no-storage, no-construction zone; any new item crossing the isolation plane needs the structural engineer's approval.

units.title: 鉛心橡膠支承的雙線性性質~Bilinear properties of lead-rubber bearings
units.mechanism: 鉛心橡膠支承由多層薄橡膠與鋼板交錯硫化而成，中心插入鉛棒：鋼板限制橡膠的側向膨脹，使支承在垂直方向很硬、水平方向很軟；鉛心在小位移時提供初始勁度與抗風強度，降伏後以塑性變形耗能，力—位移關係近似雙線性。設計參數包括鉛心特性強度 Q_d、降伏後勁度 K_d（由橡膠剪力模數、面積與總厚度決定）、有效勁度與等效阻尼比，這些值都隨位移改變。~A lead-rubber bearing is built from thin rubber layers vulcanised between steel shims with a lead plug at its centre: the shims restrain lateral bulging so the bearing is very stiff vertically and soft horizontally, while the lead core provides initial stiffness and wind resistance at small displacement and, after yielding, dissipates energy by plastic deformation, giving a roughly bilinear force–displacement curve. Design parameters are the characteristic strength Q_d of the lead, the post-yield stiffness K_d set by rubber shear modulus, area and total thickness, the effective stiffness and the equivalent damping ratio, all of which vary with displacement.
units.model: 鉛心直徑 150 mm、鉛降伏應力 10 MPa：Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN。支承直徑 900 mm、橡膠總厚 200 mm、G = 0.4 MPa：A_r ≈ 0.619 m²，K_d = G·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,237 kN/m。D = 0.40 m 時 F = 177 + 1,237×0.40 ≈ 672 kN，K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m；EDC ≈ 4×177×(0.40−0.02) ≈ 269 kJ，β_eff = EDC/(2π·K_eff·D²) ≈ 16%。數值為教學假設。~A 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d = 10×π/4×150² ≈ 177 kN. A 900 mm bearing with 200 mm total rubber and G = 0.4 MPa has A_r ≈ 0.619 m² and K_d = G·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,237 kN/m. At D = 0.40 m, F = 177 + 1,237×0.40 ≈ 672 kN and K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m; EDC ≈ 4×177×(0.40−0.02) ≈ 269 kJ and β_eff = EDC/(2π·K_eff·D²) ≈ 16%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依 ISO 22762 或 ASCE 7 隔震章節的精神，以原型試驗量測不同位移下的 Q_d、K_d、K_eff 與 EDC，並檢查垂直勁度、在最大位移下的穩定性與上浮行為；橡膠材料另做剪力模數、硬度與老化試驗。~In the spirit of ISO 22762 and the isolation chapter of ASCE 7, prototype tests measure Q_d, K_d, K_eff and EDC at several displacements and check vertical stiffness, stability at maximum displacement and uplift behaviour; rubber compounds are also tested for shear modulus, hardness and ageing.
units.failure: 若支承在最大位移下的重疊面積太小，加上大軸力，橡膠層會失穩或撕裂；鋼板與橡膠的黏結不良，則在反覆剪力下逐層剝離，支承勁度與承載力下降。~If the overlap area at maximum displacement is too small under high axial load, the rubber layers can become unstable or tear; poor bonding between shims and rubber leads to layer-by-layer delamination under cyclic shear, reducing stiffness and capacity.
units.misconception: 隔震支承的勁度與阻尼是固定值，不隨位移改變。~An isolator's stiffness and damping are fixed values that do not change with displacement.
units.practice: 規格書要列出每種支承在設計與最大位移下的 K_eff、EDC 與允收偏差，並要求每個支承有序號與試驗紀錄；同一隔震層盡量減少支承種類，避免安裝時錯置。~The specification should list K_eff, EDC and tolerances at design and maximum displacement for each bearing type, with a serial number and test record for every bearing; keep the number of bearing types in one isolation layer small to avoid mix-ups during installation.

units.anchor: 後拉預力托換梁~Post-tensioned transfer girder
units.title: 托換梁與既有基礎的荷載轉移~Transfer girders and load transfer from existing foundations
units.mechanism: 改造的關鍵是如何在不移除建築的前提下，把每根柱或每道牆的重量從原基礎轉到新隔震器上。常見做法是在柱或牆兩側澆置新的混凝土托換梁或夾套，以後拉預力把新舊混凝土夾緊，靠摩擦與剪力榫把荷載傳入新構件，再由新構件坐在隔震器上。Forell/Elsesser 的猶他州議會大廈改造即以環繞既有墩基礎的後拉預力混凝土大梁形成複合斷面，跨距約 51 ft，把約 28,000,000 lb 的荷載轉到新隔震器，避免在既有基礎下方開挖。~The key to a retrofit is moving the weight of every column or wall from the old foundation onto new isolators without removing the building. A common method casts new concrete transfer beams or jackets on both sides of a column or wall and clamps new to old concrete with post-tensioning, so that friction and shear keys carry the load into the new members, which then sit on the isolators. In the Utah State Capitol retrofit, Forell/Elsesser wrapped the existing pier footings with post-tensioned concrete girders forming composite sections, spanning about 51 ft, to transfer about 28,000,000 lb onto new isolators without excavating beneath the old footings.
units.model: 以摩擦轉移柱荷載 P = 2·μ·N（兩側夾板）。P = 4,000 kN、粗糙面摩擦係數 μ = 0.7 時，所需夾緊力 N = 4,000/(2×0.7) ≈ 2,857 kN；15.2 mm 鋼絞線（140 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa）以 0.6 f_pu 計每股約 156 kN，需 2,857/156 ≈ 18.3，取 19 股。數值為教學假設。~Transferring a column load by friction, P = 2·μ·N for two clamping faces. With P = 4,000 kN and a roughened-surface friction coefficient μ = 0.7, the clamping force is N = 4,000/(2×0.7) ≈ 2,857 kN; a 15.2 mm strand (140 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa) at 0.6 f_pu gives about 156 kN, so 2,857/156 ≈ 18.3, rounded up to 19 strands. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 施工前鑽心確認既有混凝土強度與粗糙化處理後的介面，必要時做介面剪力試驗；預力施加時記錄每束伸長量與千斤頂壓力並比對計算值，偏差超過允許值（例如 ±7%）須停工檢討。~Before construction, core the existing concrete to confirm strength and the roughened interface, with interface shear tests where needed; during stressing, record elongation and jack pressure for every tendon against calculated values and stop to investigate if deviations exceed tolerance, for example ±7%.
units.failure: 若既有混凝土強度低於假設或介面清理不足，摩擦轉移不足，荷載轉移時新舊混凝土間發生滑動，柱突然下沉並拉裂上部磚牆；預力損失估計過低，則長期夾緊力下降，轉移構件逐漸滑移。~If the existing concrete is weaker than assumed or the interface poorly prepared, friction is insufficient and new and old concrete slip during transfer, dropping the column suddenly and cracking masonry above; underestimated prestress losses let clamping fall over time so that the transfer member gradually slips.
units.misconception: 新澆托換梁只要與舊柱接觸，就能自動把柱荷載傳過去。~A newly cast transfer beam that touches the old column will automatically pick up its load.
units.practice: 荷載轉移構件的界面處理、剪力榫、預力束配置與量測紀錄表都應列為停止點，並由結構技師現場確認後才可進行下一步切柱或頂升。~Interface preparation, shear keys, tendon layout and measurement sheets for transfer members should be hold points, confirmed on site by the structural engineer before any column cutting or jacking proceeds.

units.anchor: 切柱頂升與臨時支撐~Column cutting, jacking and shoring
units.title: 切柱、頂升與沉陷控制~Cutting, jacking and settlement control
units.mechanism: 隔震器就位前，柱或牆必須被切斷，荷載暫時由千斤頂與臨時支撐承擔，再把千斤頂壓力轉到隔震器上。舊金山市政府的改造中，約 530 根柱與約 1,500 ft 的厚重磚牆被切斷並暫時頂撐，才能安裝隔震器。歷史建築對差異沉陷極為敏感，數毫米的差異就可能使灰泥裝飾開裂，因此要以千斤頂預壓抵銷隔震器受壓後的垂直變形，並按事先排定的順序逐柱施作。~Before an isolator goes in, a column or wall must be cut, its load carried temporarily by jacks and shoring, and the jack pressure then transferred onto the isolator. In the San Francisco City Hall retrofit about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft of massive brick walls were cut and temporarily jacked so that isolators could be installed. Historic buildings are very sensitive to differential settlement, where a few millimetres can crack plaster ornament, so jacks preload to offset the isolator's vertical compression, and columns are done one by one in a planned sequence.
units.model: 單層橡膠厚 10 mm 時形狀係數 S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5，壓縮模數近似 E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa，垂直勁度 K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m；柱荷載 4,000 kN 時壓縮約 1.1 mm，須以千斤頂預壓抵銷。數值為教學假設，未計體積壓縮修正。~With 10 mm rubber layers the shape factor is S = 900/(4×10) = 22.5, the compression modulus is roughly E_c ≈ 6·G·S² = 6×0.4×22.5² ≈ 1,215 MPa and the vertical stiffness K_v = E_c·A_r/t_r ≈ 1,215,000×0.619/0.2 ≈ 3.76×10⁶ kN/m; a 4,000 kN column load compresses the bearing about 1.1 mm, which jack preload must offset. Values are teaching assumptions without bulk-compressibility correction.
units.verify: 每根柱在切斷前、頂升中與轉移後以精密水準儀量測高程，並在千斤頂上記錄壓力；相鄰柱的差異沉陷超過允許值（例如 3 mm）即停止並調整，裂縫監測計與傾斜計同步記錄磚牆反應。~Level every column with a precise level before cutting, during jacking and after transfer, recording jack pressures; stop and adjust if differential settlement between neighbouring columns exceeds the limit, for example 3 mm, while crack gauges and tiltmeters record the masonry's response.
units.failure: 若一次切斷太多相鄰柱或千斤頂壓力不一致，荷載在臨時系統中重分配，部分柱瞬間下沉，造成磚牆與拱頂開裂；臨時支撐若只承受垂直力，施工中的地震或施工機具撞擊可能使其側向失穩。~Cutting too many adjacent columns at once or uneven jack pressures redistribute load within the temporary system, so some columns drop suddenly and crack masonry walls and vaults; shoring designed only for vertical load can become laterally unstable under a construction-period earthquake or equipment impact.
units.misconception: 切柱只是施工手續，只要千斤頂撐住就不會影響上部結構。~Cutting columns is a routine step; as long as jacks hold them, the superstructure is unaffected.
units.practice: 施工計畫要列出切柱順序、同時切斷柱數上限、千斤頂預壓值、沉陷與裂縫的停止條件，以及臨時支撐的側向設計，由結構技師簽認並設為每一柱的停止點；這些步驟是工程推理與檢核，不是現場操作許可。~The construction plan should list the cutting sequence, the maximum number of columns cut at once, jack preloads, stop criteria for settlement and cracking, and the lateral design of shoring, signed by the structural engineer as a hold point for every column; these steps are engineering reasoning and checks, not a field operating permit.

units.anchor: 施工期間地震風險~Construction-period earthquake risk
units.title: 施工期間的暫態結構與地震風險~Temporary structural states and earthquake risk during construction
units.mechanism: 改造期間建築處在最脆弱的狀態：部分柱已切斷、隔震器尚未全部就位、隔震縫還沒完成，原本的基礎與新系統都只是半套。Forell/Elsesser 說明舊金山市政府的施工排序，目的之一就是在施工期間萬一發生地震時仍維持結構穩定。設計者必須把每個施工階段當成一個暫態結構，決定其要承受的地震水準，並以臨時側向束制、限制同時施工範圍或分區施作來控制風險。~During a retrofit the building is at its most vulnerable: some columns are cut, not all isolators are in place and the moat is unfinished, so neither the old foundation nor the new system is complete. Forell/Elsesser explains that construction sequencing at San Francisco City Hall aimed, among other things, to keep the structure stable should an earthquake strike during the work. Designers must treat each construction stage as a temporary structure, choose the earthquake level it must resist, and control risk with temporary lateral restraints, limits on simultaneous work areas or zoned construction.
units.model: 施工期間發生某回歸期地震的機率 P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R)。工期 t = 3 年：對 475 年回歸期 P = 1 − exp(−3/475) ≈ 0.63%；對 72 年回歸期 P ≈ 1 − exp(−3/72) ≈ 4.1%，所以暫態結構至少要能安全承受較常發生的中小地震。數值為教學假設。~The probability of an earthquake of a given return period during construction is P = 1 − exp(−t/T_R). For t = 3 years: a 475-year event gives P = 1 − exp(−3/475) ≈ 0.63%, and a 72-year event P ≈ 1 − exp(−3/72) ≈ 4.1%, so temporary states must at least safely resist the more frequent moderate earthquakes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 為每個施工階段建立模型，檢查在選定的施工期地震下，臨時支撐、已切柱位與未完成區的側向強度與變形；施工中每週更新已完成與未完成的柱位圖，確認實際進度沒有超出分析過的暫態組合。~Model each construction stage and check the lateral strength and deformation of shoring, cut-column locations and unfinished zones under the selected construction-period earthquake; update a weekly plan of completed and pending column positions to confirm that actual progress stays within the analysed temporary states.
units.failure: 若施工單位為趕工而同時切斷超出計畫的柱數，結構進入沒有分析過的暫態，中度地震就可能使臨時支撐傾倒；隔震器已安裝但尚未完成隔震縫時，建築撞上開挖面的臨時擋土，也可能造成損傷。~If the contractor cuts more columns than planned to save time, the structure enters an unanalysed temporary state in which a moderate earthquake may topple shoring; with isolators installed but the moat unfinished, the building can strike temporary earth retention and suffer damage.
units.misconception: 施工期間只有幾年，不需要考慮地震。~Construction lasts only a few years, so earthquakes need not be considered.
units.practice: 合約應規定施工期地震的設計水準、同時施作範圍上限與緊急應變程序，地震後先由結構技師檢查臨時系統才可復工；進度變更須先送設計者評估暫態安全。~The contract should set the construction-period design earthquake, the maximum simultaneous work area and an emergency procedure, with work resuming after an earthquake only once the structural engineer has inspected the temporary system; any change in sequence must first go to the designer for temporary-state assessment.

units.anchor: 隔震器試驗機~Isolator test machine
units.title: 原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施~Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities
units.mechanism: 隔震器的性質必須在接近實際的軸壓、速度與位移下試驗，因為鉛心在快速大位移下會發熱、特性強度下降，橡膠性質也受速度與溫度影響。原型試驗在多個位移與軸壓組合下做反覆加載，確認穩定性與耗能；出廠試驗則對每個支承做壓縮與壓剪試驗，確認與原型一致。台灣國家地震工程研究中心的雙軸向動態測試系統（BATS）是少數能同時施加高軸壓與快速水平運動的設備，常用於隔震元件試驗。~Isolator properties must be tested under realistic axial load, velocity and displacement, because the lead core heats and loses characteristic strength in fast large cycles, and rubber properties depend on rate and temperature. Prototype tests apply repeated cycles at several displacement and axial-load combinations to confirm stability and dissipation; production tests apply compression and combined compression–shear to every bearing to confirm consistency with the prototype. The Bi-Axial Testing System (BATS) at Taiwan's National Center for Research on Earthquake Engineering is one of the few facilities able to apply high axial load with fast horizontal motion and is commonly used for isolator testing.
units.model: 某支承在 ±0.40 m 循環量得 +690 kN 與 −660 kN，K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m，比設計 1,679 kN/m 高約 0.5%；迴圈面積 250 kJ，β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%，比設計 16% 低，須確認是否在允收範圍。數值為教學假設。~A bearing cycled to ±0.40 m reads +690 kN and −660 kN, so K_eff = (690+660)/(2×0.40) ≈ 1,688 kN/m, about 0.5% above the design 1,679 kN/m; a loop area of 250 kJ gives β_eff = 250/(2π×1,688×0.40²) ≈ 14.7%, below the design 16%, which must be checked against the acceptance range. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫列出軸壓、位移振幅、循環數、速度與溫度，以及 K_eff、EDC 個別與平均的允收偏差；試驗機的力量測方式要經校正，高速試驗時須考慮致動器慣性與摩擦對量測力的影響，並由第三方見證。~The test plan lists axial loads, displacement amplitudes, cycle counts, velocities and temperatures, and acceptance tolerances for individual and average K_eff and EDC; force measurement on the test machine must be calibrated, high-speed tests must account for actuator inertia and friction in the measured force, and a third party should witness.
units.failure: 若原型試驗只做慢速試驗，鉛心發熱造成的強度下降未被量到，分析高估了阻尼，實際位移超過隔震縫；出廠試驗若只抽樣，個別支承的黏結缺陷可能在地震中才暴露。~Slow-only prototype tests miss the strength loss from lead heating, so analysis overstates damping and real displacement exceeds the moat; sampling instead of testing every production bearing can leave individual bonding defects to reveal themselves in an earthquake.
units.misconception: 隔震器只要在慢速試驗中合格，地震時的性質就一定相同。~If an isolator passes slow-speed tests, its properties in an earthquake will be the same.
units.practice: 採購文件要求原型試驗速度接近設計速度，或以經核可的方法換算速度效應；每個支承的試驗報告與序號要與安裝位置對照，不合格品不得以修正係數放行。~Procurement documents should require prototype test velocities close to design velocity, or an approved method to account for rate effects; every bearing's test report and serial number must match its installed location, and failed units may not be released with correction factors.

units.anchor: 隔震層上下強震儀~Strong-motion sensors above and below isolation
units.title: 強震監測與實際性能判讀~Strong-motion monitoring and interpreting real performance
units.mechanism: 隔震建築應在隔震層下方、上方與屋頂設置強震儀，並在隔震層設位移計，才能在地震後判斷隔震是否如預期作用。中小地震時鉛心可能未完全降伏，系統較硬、週期較短，加速度折減不如設計地震明顯，判讀時不能用設計週期直接比較。鹽湖城市郡大樓在 2020 年規模 5.7 地震後只需輕微修復，這類實際事件與紀錄是隔震改造最有說服力的驗證。~An isolated building should carry strong-motion instruments below and above the isolation layer and at the roof, with displacement transducers in the isolation layer, so that engineers can judge after an earthquake whether isolation worked as intended. In small and moderate events the lead cores may not fully yield, so the system is stiffer with a shorter period and acceleration reduction is less marked than in the design earthquake; records must not be compared directly with the design period. After a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020 the Salt Lake City and County Building needed only minor repairs, and such real events and records are the most convincing verification of an isolation retrofit.
units.model: 隔震位移僅 0.03 m 時，單一支承 F = 177 + 1,237×0.03 ≈ 214 kN，K_eff ≈ 7,130 kN/m，54 個合計約 384,900 kN/m，T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×384,900)) ≈ 1.5 s，只有設計位移 0.40 m 時 3.1 s 的一半。數值為教學假設。~At only 0.03 m isolator displacement, one bearing carries F = 177 + 1,237×0.03 ≈ 214 kN, so K_eff ≈ 7,130 kN/m and 54 bearings total about 384,900 kN/m, giving T = 2π√(216,000/(9.81×384,900)) ≈ 1.5 s, half the 3.1 s at the 0.40 m design displacement. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 地震後比較隔震層上下的尖峰加速度與傅立葉譜，計算傳遞比，並以位移計或刮痕板讀取最大位移；以紀錄反算的有效週期與阻尼，和相同位移下的雙線性模型預測比較，差異過大時檢查是否有障礙物阻擋或支承損傷。~After an earthquake, compare peak accelerations and Fourier spectra above and below the isolation layer to compute transfer ratios, and read maximum displacement from transducers or scratch plates; compare effective period and damping back-calculated from records with the bilinear model at the same displacement, and check for obstructions or bearing damage where they differ greatly.
units.failure: 若沒有隔震層下方的強震儀，就無法區分加速度降低是因為隔震還是地動本身較弱；若隔震縫被雜物或後來增建的構造卡住，紀錄會顯示上部加速度突然尖峰，代表發生撞擊。~Without an instrument below the isolation layer, nobody can tell whether lower acceleration came from isolation or simply weaker ground motion; if debris or later construction blocks the moat, records show sudden acceleration spikes above the layer, the signature of impact.
units.misconception: 小地震時隔震建築的加速度折減應該和設計地震一樣大。~In a small earthquake an isolated building should show the same acceleration reduction as in the design earthquake.
units.practice: 業主應編列強震儀維護與資料判讀預算，地震後在約定時間內由結構技師提出簡報，說明最大位移、傳遞比與是否需要檢查支承；紀錄長期保存供後續研究與再評估。~Owners should budget for instrument maintenance and data interpretation, with the structural engineer reporting within an agreed time after each earthquake on maximum displacement, transfer ratios and whether bearings need inspection; keep records permanently for research and reassessment.

units.anchor: 性質修正係數~Property modification factors
units.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限分析~Ageing, temperature and upper- and lower-bound analysis
units.mechanism: 隔震器的性質不是固定值：橡膠會隨時間硬化、低溫時變硬，鉛心在連續大位移中發熱而強度下降，製造批次也有變異。因此設計不採用單一性質，而以性質修正係數產生上限與下限兩組性質分別分析：下限性質（較軟、阻尼較低）決定最大位移與隔震縫寬度，上限性質（較硬、強度較高）決定上部結構與托換構件的設計力。改造案的上部結構往往只有有限的強度，對上限力特別敏感。~Isolator properties are not fixed: rubber stiffens with age and at low temperature, lead cores heat and lose strength in repeated large cycles, and production batches vary. Design therefore uses property modification factors to create upper- and lower-bound property sets analysed separately: the lower bound, softer with less damping, governs maximum displacement and moat width, while the upper bound, stiffer and stronger, governs forces on the superstructure and transfer members. In a retrofit the superstructure often has limited strength and is especially sensitive to upper-bound forces.
units.model: 上限取 Q_d×1.3、K_d×1.1：F_up = 1.3×177 + 1.1×1,237×0.40 ≈ 774 kN，為名目 672 kN 的 1.15 倍；下限取 Q_d×0.85、K_d×0.9：F_lo = 0.85×177 + 0.9×1,237×0.40 ≈ 596 kN，系統週期由 3.1 s 增為約 3.3 s，位移需求隨之增加。修正係數為教學假設。~Upper bound with Q_d×1.3 and K_d×1.1: F_up = 1.3×177 + 1.1×1,237×0.40 ≈ 774 kN, 1.15 times the nominal 672 kN; lower bound with Q_d×0.85 and K_d×0.9: F_lo = 0.85×177 + 0.9×1,237×0.40 ≈ 596 kN, lengthening the system period from 3.1 s to about 3.3 s and raising displacement demand. The factors are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 性質修正係數須以製造商的老化、溫度、速度與循環試驗資料為依據；設計報告同時列出上下限分析的最大位移、基底剪力與上部結構需求比，並在維護計畫中規定定期抽檢或量測支承變形與外觀。~Property modification factors must rest on the manufacturer's ageing, temperature, rate and cycling test data; the design report lists maximum displacement, base shear and superstructure demand ratios for both bounds, and the maintenance plan requires periodic inspection of bearing deformation and condition.
units.failure: 若只以名目性質分析，橡膠多年硬化後實際傳入上部結構的力比設計高一至兩成，脆弱的磚牆或石材裝飾可能在設計地震中受損；低溫地區若忽略橡膠硬化，冬季地震的隔震效果也會打折。~Analysing only nominal properties means that after years of rubber stiffening the forces reaching the superstructure are 10% to 20% above design, so brittle masonry or stone ornament can be damaged in the design earthquake; ignoring low-temperature stiffening in cold climates also reduces isolation in a winter earthquake.
units.misconception: 只要用試驗量到的名目性質分析，隔震設計就涵蓋了全部情況。~Analysing with the nominal tested properties covers every case in isolation design.
units.practice: 交接文件中列出每種支承的名目、上限與下限性質及其依據，任何更換支承都必須落在同一上下限範圍內；外觀檢查項目包括橡膠龜裂、鋼板外露鏽蝕、殘留側向變形與錨栓。~Handover documents list nominal, upper- and lower-bound properties and their basis for each bearing type, and any replacement bearing must fall within the same bounds; visual inspection covers rubber cracking, exposed or corroded shims, residual lateral offset and anchor bolts.

units.anchor: 隔震縫淨空與管線接頭~Moat clearance and utility joints
units.title: 隔震縫維護、事件後檢查與交接~Moat maintenance, post-event inspection and handover
units.mechanism: 隔震改造完成後，最常見的失效不是支承本身，而是隔震縫被逐漸填滿：新增的花台、儲藏物、管線支架、甚至修繕時加砌的牆，都可能在多年後把建築與地盤重新卡在一起。穿越隔震面的水管、瓦斯管、電纜與排水管也必須保留足夠的可動長度。因此交接文件與日常維護必須把隔震縫當成結構構件管理，並在每次地震後檢查支承、可動接頭與隔震縫是否完整。~After an isolation retrofit, the most common failure is not the bearings but the moat gradually filling up: new planters, storage, pipe supports or even walls added during repairs can lock the building to the ground again years later. Water, gas, power and drainage lines crossing the isolation plane must also keep enough movable length. Handover documents and routine maintenance must therefore manage the moat as a structural element, and after every earthquake inspect bearings, flexible joints and moat clearance.
units.model: 若隔震縫被後來的構造縮減到 0.30 m，而設計位移為 0.40 m：系統質量約 216,000/9.81 ≈ 22,000 t，ω = 2π/3.1 ≈ 2.03 rad/s，在 0.30 m 處速度 v = ω·√(0.40² − 0.30²) ≈ 0.54 m/s，撞擊動能 ½mv² ≈ 0.5×22.0×10⁶×0.54² ≈ 3.2 MJ，全部傳入局部牆體與上部結構。數值為教學假設。~If later construction reduces the moat to 0.30 m while the design displacement is 0.40 m: the system mass is about 216,000/9.81 ≈ 22,000 t, ω = 2π/3.1 ≈ 2.03 rad/s, the velocity at 0.30 m is v = ω·√(0.40² − 0.30²) ≈ 0.54 m/s and the impact energy ½mv² ≈ 0.5×22.0×10⁶×0.54² ≈ 3.2 MJ, all delivered into local walls and the superstructure. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每年沿隔震縫全周量測淨寬並拍照，檢查蓋板、伸縮踏板與管線可動接頭；地震後依檢查表記錄支承殘留變形、橡膠龜裂、鉛心外露、錨栓與刮痕板讀數，必要時抽樣更換支承並重新試驗。~Each year measure and photograph the clear width all round the moat and inspect covers, sliding treads and flexible utility joints; after an earthquake record residual bearing offset, rubber cracking, lead exposure, anchor bolts and scratch-plate readings against a checklist, replacing and re-testing sample bearings where needed.
units.failure: 管理單位不了解隔震縫的功能，把它當成可利用空間，或在外牆修繕時加設與地面相連的構造，強震時建築撞擊並失去隔震效益；管線可動長度不足，則在地震中拉斷，造成漏水、漏氣或火災。~Managers who do not understand the moat treat it as usable space or add structures tied to the ground during façade repairs, so the building collides and loses its isolation in a strong earthquake; utilities without enough movable length snap, causing water or gas leaks or fire.
units.misconception: 隔震改造完成後，隔震縫只是一條空隙，不需要維護。~Once the retrofit is complete, the moat is just a gap that needs no maintenance.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含隔震設計基準、支承位置與性質表、上下限分析結果、隔震縫與可動接頭圖、檢查週期與事件後檢查表，並明訂任何在隔震縫範圍內的施作須先經結構技師核可。~Handover should include the isolation design basis, bearing location and property tables, bound-analysis results, plans of the moat and flexible joints, inspection intervals and the post-event checklist, and state that any work within the moat zone requires prior approval by the structural engineer.

example: 設計練習：某歷史建築重 W = 216,000 kN，以 54 個鉛心橡膠支承隔震。單一支承：鉛心 150 mm、降伏應力 10 MPa，Q_d ≈ 177 kN；直徑 900 mm、橡膠總厚 200 mm、G = 0.4 MPa，K_d ≈ 1,237 kN/m。設計位移 D = 0.40 m 時 F ≈ 672 kN，K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m，β_eff ≈ 16%。系統 K ≈ 90,650 kN/m，T = 2π√(W/(g·K)) ≈ 3.1 s；以 S_D1 = 0.7、B = 1.35，D = g·S_D1·T/(4π²·B) ≈ 9.81×0.7×3.1/(39.48×1.35) ≈ 0.40 m，與假設一致；基底剪力係數約 0.17，約為固定基底的六分之一。平面 60 m × 30 m、偏心 3 m 時角落總位移約 0.50 m，隔震縫取 0.55 m 以上。若採用上限性質（Q_d×1.3、K_d×1.1），單一支承力增為約 774 kN，上部結構設計力增加約 15%；若隔震縫被縮減到 0.30 m，撞擊動能約 3.2 MJ。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Design exercise: a historic building weighing W = 216,000 kN is isolated on 54 lead-rubber bearings. For one bearing, a 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d ≈ 177 kN, and a 900 mm diameter with 200 mm total rubber and G = 0.4 MPa gives K_d ≈ 1,237 kN/m. At the design displacement D = 0.40 m, F ≈ 672 kN, K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m and β_eff ≈ 16%. The system K ≈ 90,650 kN/m gives T = 2π√(W/(g·K)) ≈ 3.1 s; with S_D1 = 0.7 and B = 1.35, D = g·S_D1·T/(4π²·B) ≈ 9.81×0.7×3.1/(39.48×1.35) ≈ 0.40 m, consistent with the assumption, and the base-shear coefficient is about 0.17, roughly one sixth of the fixed-base value. For a 60 m × 30 m plan with 3 m eccentricity the corner displacement is about 0.50 m, so the moat should be at least 0.55 m. Upper-bound properties (Q_d×1.3, K_d×1.1) raise the bearing force to about 774 kN, about 15% more superstructure force; a moat reduced to 0.30 m means an impact energy of about 3.2 MJ. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: Forell/Elsesser 在 1980 年代初期開始把基礎隔震用於建築，鹽湖城市郡大樓在多年整修後於 1989 年重新開放，被該公司稱為全球第一個以基礎隔震改造的既有建築。同年 Loma Prieta 地震損壞舊金山市政府，其後的改造切斷約 530 根柱與約 1,500 ft 磚牆以安裝隔震器，成為當時最大的隔震結構；奧克蘭市政府的隔震改造則是當時最高的隔震建築。猶他州議會大廈後來以 256 個隔震器與後拉預力托換梁完成改造，2020 年規模 5.7 地震也驗證了鹽湖城市郡大樓的隔震效益。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Forell/Elsesser began applying base isolation to buildings in the early 1980s, and the Salt Lake City and County Building, reopened in 1989 after a multi-year renovation, is described by the firm as the world's first base-isolation retrofit of an existing building. In the same year the Loma Prieta earthquake damaged San Francisco City Hall, whose subsequent retrofit cut about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft of brick walls to install isolators and became the largest isolated structure of its time, while the Oakland City Hall isolation retrofit was then the tallest. The Utah State Capitol was later retrofitted with 256 isolators and post-tensioned transfer girders, and a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020 confirmed the benefit of isolation at the Salt Lake City and County Building. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 鹽湖城市郡大樓建於 1891 至 1894 年，鐘塔高約 78 m（256 ft），1989 年完成隔震改造後重新開放~The Salt Lake City and County Building was built in 1891 to 1894 with a clock tower about 78 m (256 ft) high and reopened in 1989 after its isolation retrofit
鹽湖城市郡大樓在 2020 年規模 5.7 地震後只需輕微修復~The Salt Lake City and County Building needed only minor repairs after a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020
舊金山市政府建於 1912 年，面積約 550,000 平方呎（約 51,000 m²），1989 年 Loma Prieta 地震受損~San Francisco City Hall, built in 1912 with about 550,000 sq ft (about 51,000 m²), was damaged in the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake
舊金山市政府改造時切斷約 530 根柱與約 1,500 ft（約 457 m）磚牆並暫時頂撐~The San Francisco City Hall retrofit cut and temporarily jacked about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft (about 457 m) of brick walls
猶他州議會大廈下方設有 256 個隔震器，可向任一方向側移約 24 in（約 610 mm）~The Utah State Capitol sits on 256 isolators able to move about 24 in (about 610 mm) in any direction

猶他州議會大廈以跨距約 51 ft（約 15.5 m）的後拉預力托換梁轉移約 28,000,000 lb（約 125 MN）荷載~The Utah State Capitol retrofit transferred about 28,000,000 lb (about 125 MN) through post-tensioned girders spanning about 51 ft (about 15.5 m)
猶他州議會大廈 1916 年完工，外穹頂高出地面約 235 ft（約 72 m）~The Utah State Capitol was completed in 1916, with its outer dome about 235 ft (about 72 m) above ground
Forell/Elsesser 表示已為 30 棟以上建築提供隔震可行性研究或設計~Forell/Elsesser reports base-isolation feasibility studies or designs for more than 30 buildings

鹽湖城附近規模 5.7 地震，隔震改造的市郡大樓只需輕微修復~A magnitude 5.7 earthquake near Salt Lake City leaves the isolated City and County Building needing only minor repairs
